pair.title: Add a Xiaomi device
pair.intro: Enter the details of your device. The IP address and token are found in the Mi Home app or in your router.
pair.startIntro: How do you want to add your device?
pair.addressWarning: Give your device a fixed IP address in your router, so Homey keeps finding it.
pair.search: Search for devices on my network
pair.searchHelp: The app looks for Xiaomi devices that answer on your network.
pair.manualHelp: You know the IP address and the token of the device.
pair.account: Log in with my Xiaomi account
pair.accountHelp: Scan a QR code with the Mi Home app and get the token automatically.
pair.accountIntro: Open the Mi Home app on your phone and scan this QR code to log in. Your login goes straight to Xiaomi and is not stored.
pair.accountSignedIn: Logged in. Looking for your devices…
pair.accountNoDevices: No supported devices found in your Xiaomi account.
pair.accountChoose: Choose your device. Its name, address and token are filled in.
pair.discoverIntro: Choose your device. Then enter its name and token.
pair.name: Name
pair.pollingHelp: How often the device state is read. The minimum is 5 seconds.
pair.noDevices: No devices found. Enter the IP address yourself.

errors.name_and_address_required: Enter a name and an IP address.
errors.token_invalid: The token must be 32 hexadecimal characters.
errors.device_unreachable: Cannot reach the device. Check the IP address and token.
errors.discovery_failed: Searching the network failed. Enter the IP address yourself.
errors.login_unavailable: Cannot reach the Xiaomi account. Try again later.
errors.not_signed_in: Log in with your Xiaomi account first.
